semiconductor_relevance: High — Huifeng Diamond specializes in superhard materials used for cutting, grinding, and polishing in semiconductor applications.
summary: Huifeng Diamond Co., Ltd. is a high-tech enterprise focused on the production of superhard diamond micro powders and abrasive materials for the semiconductor industry. Their products are primarily utilized in the processing of silicon carbide substrates and other hard materials critical for semiconductor manufacturing.
capabilities: Abrasive materials for grinding and polishing
Cutting tools for hard and brittle materials

regional_presence.China: The company is based in Shangqiu City, Henan Province, and has multiple subsidiaries across the country.
